                                  Other Restrictions for all Weapon Types
All shapes must be conform with the Shields and Buckler rule document
The Radius of striking edge must be more than 7 cm.
Only Shields which have chronological validity of a specific historical period as confirmed by the
Authenticity Committee are allowed.
